title: Schlechter's Immortal | Hey Lady Do you know how to play chess | Shunya
desc:
A quiet duel of hearts and strategy.
Where desire feels dangerous and beautiful.
Some games are played even when you know the cost. #nightvibes #emotionalmusic #cinematicpop #headphones #shunya
thumbnailPrompt: A cinematic wide shot of a moonlit castle interior turned ballroom, marble floors reflecting soft candlelight. A fierce elegant woman and a solemn man face each other like chess opponents, tension in their eyes. Realistic-anime characters with watercolor softness, semi-realistic textures, flowing fabric, dramatic shadows, cool blue moonlight mixed with warm gold glow, emotional atmosphere, wallpaper-quality framing, no text.
lyrics:
[Intro — Spoken softly, echo of a ballroom]
Hey lady,
Do you know how to play chess?
Obvious tricks, obvious bait…
I won’t fall for it.

[Verse 1]
That’s the way of the world, they say,
When a trick fails, it turns to comedy.
You made your move, I read the play,
But your eyes—they checkmate me.

[Pre-Chorus]
The pawn rushes forward, breaking lines,
Your silence feels like a sign.
Hey miss, step aside tonight,
Your heart’s the board, and I take my time.

[Chorus]
Come into my castle, fierce lady,
The gates are open, but the game is heavy.
My heart’s a blade, cold and ready,
To clash with yours—so wild, so steady.
Come into my castle, fierce lady,
You entered once—now stay already.

[Verse 2]
You strike like thunder, bold and free,
A queen who laughs at strategy.
I gave my gift—a wounded pride,
Yet still I want you by my side.

[Pre-Chorus 2]
Every smile’s a feint, every glance a blow,
We dance where only danger grows.
You can’t stop me from breaking through,
I’ll play this game until I lose to you.

[Chorus]
Come into my castle, fierce lady,
The gates are open, but the game is heavy.
My heart’s a blade, cold and ready,
To clash with yours—so wild, so steady.
Come into my castle, fierce lady,
You entered once—now stay already.

[Bridge — instrumental break with violin and piano duel]
(Whispered)
A move, a smile, a broken line…
Your heart was mine—but now it’s fine.
That’s the way of the world, they say,
When a trick fails—it’s just a play.

[Final Chorus — slower, grander]
Come into my castle, fierce lady,
Now the world fades, only we remain.
You entered once—and though I’m bleeding,
I’ll never let you go again.

[Outro — whispered / fading piano]
That’s the way of the world…
When love’s the trick,
We both get played.
